title: Word and line deletes follow I4 mapping; inside a table cell they stay inside that cell
context: PR 180 (mitosis/input) review: NoteActions._deleteTo deleted the raw source range between the layout boundary and the caret. Across a non-active line or a table cell it took hidden markers, pipes and delimiter rows. The finding named the cell clamp but did not cover a word delete that starts outside a table and reaches into it.
options: only the finding's fix: sourceRangeForVisible plus a clamp to the caret's cell
also split ranges that enter a table from outside at table cells, as mapDelta already does (splitAtTables)
change nothing when a word delete from outside would enter a table
outcome: Map through sourceRangeForVisible. When the caret is in a table cell, clamp to that cell's content range (spec T2, and it matches Backspace at a separator changing nothing). Otherwise split at tables the way the input-method delta path does, so the key path and the input-method path agree and hidden table bytes are never deleted. _splitAtTables became public splitAtTables in delta_mapping.dart. Committed as df4f383.
